title: DLinear versus per-series annual periodic residual View
hypothesis: A per-series phase coordinate over an input-derived annual residual harmonic improves future Exchange-Rate macro MASE over hard sharing, same-byte seasonal gain, tuned naive forecasts and DLinear, while costing fewer bytes than free per-series Fourier coefficients.
physical_object: Pinned DLinear shared seasonal/trend linear maps plus fixed annual sinusoid basis
mirror_coordinate: One learned phase scalar per currency, rotating input-projected annual residual (cos,sin) coefficients
logical_multiplicity: Eight currency-specific periodic residual forecast functions

data.target_origin_definition: first index of forecast target; each [origin,origin+horizon) must be inside its registered target split
data.split: First 60% train, next 20% development, final 20% audit by original row order; audit contexts may use prior observations, target endpoints cannot cross split end.
data.normalization: Per-series mean/std fit on first 60% only; MASE denominator is training mean absolute difference at lag 252.

model.mirror_operator: From the DLinear input seasonal residual x - moving_average(x,25), project the annual sine/cosine pair over the history window. Add future harmonic a*cos(2*pi*(t+1)/252+m_i)+b*sin(2*pi*(t+1)/252+m_i), with one trainable m_i per currency. No trend or DLinear weights are changed.
model.fixed_control_operator: Same projected harmonic at m=0 with no code.
model.gain_control_operator: Same projected harmonic at m=0 multiplied by one trainable gain per currency (same number of learned scalars as phase code).

controls: Pinned official shared DLinear, context/lr selected on development
DLinear plus fixed zero-phase annual residual harmonic
DLinear plus equal-byte per-currency seasonal gain
DLinear plus factorized per-currency phase Mirror
DLinear plus free per-currency annual sine/cosine coefficients (upper control)
Eight independently trained official DLinear models
Annual seasonal naive with dev-selected shared blend between last-value and seasonal repeat

development.selection_metric: Select context in {252,504} and lr in {0.001,0.005} by development macro MASE; tune seasonal naive blend on same development block. Use seed 105601 and 100 updates for screen, then freeze context/lr and all gates.
development.limits: The development loader stops at row 6070 and never loads the final 20%. No audit target or audit metric is loaded or computed before freeze. Development windows use only targets inside the registered 20% development interval.

fresh.audit: Final chronological 20% target intervals for all eight series; 96-step non-overlapping target blocks.

fixed_reconstructible: annual sine/cosine templates generated exactly from recorded period and index

success_gate: On audit seeds 105602 and 105603, Mirror improves macro MASE by at least 2% over DLinear, equal-byte seasonal gain and tuned naive blend in both seeds; seen-series dev error is not degraded by >2%; serialized state is smaller than free sine/cosine coefficients and inference is no more than 1.25x shared DLinear latency.
failure_gate: Any success condition fails or a same-byte gain/simple harmonic control matches Mirror within 1%.
boundaries: One public benchmark family; series are currencies from a shared chronological panel, not independent worlds.
Fixed update screen; no capacity claim.
Phase rotation is a reparameterization of the native harmonic coefficient pair; any claimed value must be compression or optimization beyond matched controls.
